interface.longDescription: Create music, gaming, streaming, podcast and music-video projects in a private local dashboard. Mix stems, create MIDI sketches, render artwork/footage music videos with waveform and chroma key, arrange cuts, correct captions, write versioned lyrics/scripts/notes, discover installed editors, and review fixed production or diagnostic workflows. Twelve local MCP tools inspect, save and propose; exact execution is reviewed in the owner hub. Includes the selected EmberBanter brand kit. Laptop execution is required. Phone control needs private HTTPS pairing; ChatGPT mobile cannot execute this local stdio package. No hosted bridge, autonomous source rewriting, full DAW control, public go-live or publishing integration is claimed.
